description: Public summary of the mathematical reviews; not a verbatim audit report.

independent_proof_audit.outcome: PASS: no mathematical error or missing hypothesis found in the general theorem; the strictly increasing special case follows.
checks: Endpoint common denominator and exact cumulative-logarithm identity
Polynomial and exponential tail estimates with constants uniform in moving endpoints
First peak after a slow index and divergence of all selected indices
Near and far parts of the same cleared tail both tending to zero
Comparison with the cited sufficient base 2 and rational constructions at base sqrt(2)
independent_proof_audit.independence: The auditor recorded mathematical conclusions before consulting the earlier cooperating-session reviews.
independent_proof_audit.scope: Analytic proof audit, not formal verification, a sharpness result, or an exhaustive priority assessment. No numerical certificate is required.

manuscript_review.outcome: PASS in separate correctness and exposition reviews by a cooperating research session.
manuscript_review.scope: Complete manuscript source, including its original series indexing and equivalent recurrence argument for eventual exponential growth. Distinct from the independent audit of the underlying proof.

subsequent_editorial_changes: Added direct citations to Erdos (1975) and Erdos-Graham (1980), with precise methodological pointers and the classical base-2 comparison for unit numerators.
Shortened the Verification section to two sentences.

current_manuscript.assembly_checks: The mathematical statements and proof are unchanged by the editorial revisions. The PDF builds without warnings; all six pages were visually checked.
